status: post-deadline research update; all 2025-2026 outcomes were already inspected in earlier versions and are KNOWN benchmarks, not new holdouts
development: 2023-09-01 to 2024-12-31; monthly expanding-window fits; six chronological reporting blocks
exclude: February 2026 from primary analysis because archive publication/forecast-horizon provenance is unclear; original Claude results preserved separately
weather_input: uploaded UTC hourly CSV; no issue time or forecast lead; source model/reanalysis product unspecified; not verified observations or one-day-ahead forecasts
weather_aggregation: require exactly24 unique finite hourly rows per variable; vector-average wind direction; rainfall sum; preserve UTC date
weather_timing: primary features use UTC daily weather ending on origin date minus1 day; no target-date or same-day weather; this is a conservative date-label alignment, not certified operational availability
model_comparison: ridge alpha100/1000 on original full33 vs original full33 plus12 weather features; selection by pooled development MAE; paired same-alpha ablation reported
probabilistic_models: conditional analog next-day-change distributions, k30/60/120, inverse-distance weighting, history subset with/without weather; each gives q10/q50/q90 and exceedance probabilities35/55/100; baselines are expanding and trailing180 empirical-change distributions centered on persistence
probabilistic_selection: lowest pooled development CRPS among learned models; best baseline chosen separately by same score; ties declared order; no later tuning
proper_scores: exact weighted empirical CRPS, pinball0.1/0.5/0.9, Brier35/55/100, 80% interval score; probability reliability in five fixed equal-width bins with counts
subgroups: winter/nonwinter; prior-day abrupt PM change above predevelopment90th percentile; rain/no-rain in lagged weather; stagnant wind below predevelopment25th percentile; realized spike above predevelopment90th percentile (retrospective outcome-defined, not operational selector)
warning_cost: probability >1/(1+c) for assumed miss:false-alarm cost c:1; thresholds35/55/100 and costs1/3/5; all assumptions illustrative, not stakeholder supplied
uncertainty_claim: estimated probability of a CAMS series exceeding an illustrative threshold, NOT probability outdoor activity is safe; no calibration guarantee
control: best ML and baseline specifications frozen from development before benchmark scoring; no untouched test remains; new external evidence needed
source_status: ground monitors, archived issue-time CAMS, stakeholder responses and other-city series are absent and must not be fabricated
